Construction of a Deep Well with a Pump

Preliminary Investigations

Hydrogeological investigation site selection

Water quality testing (chemical + bacteriological)

Pumping test (2–4 hours)

Bore Hole drilling and Construction

Drilling of 150 mm (6") tube well (avg 175 ft ≈ 53 m @ Rs 3,500–4,500/ft)

PVC casing (150 mm, Class 10)

Well screen strainer (150 mm)

Gravel packing

Development by airlift flushing

Pumping Unit & Accessories

1.5 HP Submersible pump (suitable for 150 mm bore)

Delivery pipe, clamps and fittings

Cable and control panel

Pump installation

Civil Works

Construction of concrete well head apron

Protective enclosure

Transport & Miscellaneous

Contingencies 10%

Construction of 2.5 m x 2.5 m x 1.5 m (L x W x h) storage tank

Site preparation & setting out

Plywood form work including making, fixing & removing for structure -05 uses

Cutting, Bending & Placing tor steel reinforcement bars

1:2:4 (20mm) concrete with concrete mixer (volume batching)

Plaster 12mm thick in 1:3 cement and sand finished smooth with gray cement floating

Fabricating & fixing security weld mesh in open-type buildings in GI weld mesh 50mm x 50mm SWG 10, welded on 40mm x 40mm x 5mm angle frame complete with application of two coats enamel paint over two coats of anticorrosive paint and complete. All as per detail drawing No.CPC/CS/11/04/2017/TYPE-ST/07

Connecting of the Pump with the storage tank with necessary pipes & fittings
